first.rationale: The current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Memory_86 and memory_91 demonstrate proven levers for improving activation metrics—onboarding shortening and in-product activation messaging both drove measurable week-one engagement gains. Verification of these two memories will confirm their durability and magnitude before committing. Activation_messaging is the safest choice: it directly addresses the 6% activation decline, carries no documented retention risk (unlike memory_73's promotional pricing trap), and leverages an established pattern. It avoids the competitor pricing threat (not a sustainable differentiation lever) and preserves focus on qualified revenue over acquisition volume. Onboarding simplification (memory_31) is secondary but may be validated post-hoc if activation messaging alone proves insufficient. Referral (memory_57) and enterprise sales assist (memory_44) are lower-priority given the immediate activation shortfall. This experiment preserves uncertainty around root cause—whether activation decline is messaging, product experience, or market shift—while testing the most direct remediation path.

final.rationale: Archive verification confirms both levers work. Memory_86 (onboarding shortening) delivered +13% completion, -2.1 day time-to-value, and +3% retention. Memory_91 (in-product activation messaging) delivered +6% activation lift with +1% retention buffer. Current situation shows activation down 6% QoQ and onboarding completion down 4% QoQ. Activation_messaging is the immediate remediation: it directly addresses the 6% activation shortfall, has proven +6% lift from a similar baseline, carries minimal retention risk (+1%), and does not expose us to the competitor's pricing war or the retention cliff documented in memory_73. Onboarding shortening is complementary but secondary; activation messaging targets the most acute metric decline and can be deployed faster. This preserves long-term qualified revenue by rebuilding engagement velocity without sacrificing unit economics or retention. The experiment runs at standard scale to balance speed, statistical confidence, and risk containment.
